title: USD/JPY: a note on the post above
body: USD/JPY: a note on the post above. It is the final result of our earlier plan, registered on 17 Nov, whose time exit was 18 Nov at 13:30 ET, and it was posted late. As we said on 17 Nov, price reached that plan's entry zone, but a fault on our side meant no position was opened. It is not about the plan registered on 20 Nov: that plan's entry filled on 20 Nov, and its result will follow in its own post.
authority: Ops Product, 23 Nov 2026: readers took post 230 (t.me/CapitalChronicle/230, the 17 Nov plan's result corrected by CC-648) for the 20 Nov plan (the Ops Advisor's finding); decision 136, a correction is a new post.
